# Britannica

> Britannica's Curiosity Compass is an interactive platform that explores personality types, curiosity traits, and the stories of history's most inquisitive minds.

The Curiosity Compass combines personality assessment with educational content about famous explorers, scientists, and adventurers who shaped human knowledge and discovery. It uses interactive quizzes and personality profiling to help users understand their own curiosity type while learning about remarkable curious individuals throughout history.

- Curiosity Compass
- Personality Assessment
- Explorer Personality
- Curiosity Types

## Curiosity Compass

- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass](https://curiosity.britannica.com/): Interactive personality quiz exploring curiosity types and famous curious minds
- [Britannica's Curiosity Compass: I'm an Explorer!](https://curiosity.britannica.com/explorer): Explorer personality profile from Curiosity Compass featuring discovery-focused traits
